name: ui_e
prompt:
A sheet of 9 separate game interface panels on a fully transparent background, in a 3 by 3 grid, each panel a landscape rectangle about 3 wide by 2 high, centred in its own cell with wide empty transparent gaps between them. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels.

Image 1 is a style reference only: match its panel layout, palette, materials, wear and rendering exactly, and draw none of the panels in it. Unlike image 1, every asset here is drawn flat and face on (or straight down for floor), with no perspective.

Style: 1970s-80s "used future" heavy-duty industrial machinery aboard a corporate cargo spaceship. Painted metal in dull, muted dark yellow, mustard yellow and burnt orange over grey and black steel, occasional yellow-black hazard stripes, visible bolts and rivets, worn paint, scuffs — used, not ruined. Glass is reinforced with a blue-green tint. Off-white parts are worn plastic. Lamps are green, amber or red. Colours dull and desaturated. Crisp game-asset rendering, lighting from the top left.

Each panel is the flat, face-on, stylised front control panel of one machine, used as the background of that machine's control window. Every panel has the same layout: a thick heavy-duty outer frame in that machine's own paint, bolted at the corners; a top strip about one fifth of the panel's height carrying that machine's own mechanical controls — dials, analog gauges, toggle switches, push buttons, lamps, a blank riveted nameplate on the left — chosen to suit the machine; and below it the rest of the panel, about four fifths of its height, one large plain flat recessed bay of dark grey steel with nothing on it at all, left empty. Mechanical controls only; a machine marked HIGH-TECH also has one small green phosphor screen in its top strip.
Panels in reading order (row 1 left to right, then row 2, then row 3):
1. Aquarium — mustard frame; an air pump toggle, a filter lamp, a blue-green sight window.
2. Grain mill — mustard frame; a stone gap knob, a big start push button, a flour level gauge.
3. Oil press — yellow frame; a press hand wheel, a pressure gauge, a drip tray lever.
4. Galley stove — mustard and grey frame; four burner knobs, an oven temperature dial.
5. Food dehydrator — mustard frame; a fan toggle, a heat dial, a timer dial.
6. Sleep tablet press — mustard frame; a press lever, a counter dial, a hopper lamp.
7. Culture fermenter — grey and mustard frame; a stirrer knob, a pH gauge, a small green phosphor readout. HIGH-TECH.
8. Dressing station — off-white frame with an orange stripe; a lamp toggle, a drawer latch, a basin tap.
9. Isotope chemlab — lead-grey frame with hazard stripes; glove port lamps, a radiation gauge, a small green phosphor readout. HIGH-TECH.
